title: Mimic API + MotionSpec IR contract
description: GENERATED by `make contract` from api/app (Pydantic). Do not edit. Root validates a ResultEnvelope; every API model is under $defs.

AdminUser.description: One account as seen by an admin.
AdminUser.title: AdminUser

AdminUserList.description: ``GET /api/admin/users``: every account, sorted by username (no pagination).
AdminUserList.title: AdminUserList

video_url.description: H.264 preview; null if the transcode failed.
video_url.title: Video Url

Box.description: Axis-aligned rectangle in CSS px, full-frame coordinates (x, y = top-left).
Box.title: Box

ChangePasswordRequest.description: ``POST /api/auth/password`` body. The policy is checked in code (``weak_password``).
ChangePasswordRequest.title: ChangePasswordRequest

Confidence.description: A 0..1 score plus its band. ``band`` must equal ``band_for(value)``.
Confidence.title: Confidence

CreateUserRequest.description: ``POST /api/admin/users`` body. The username is stripped + lowercased, then validated.
CreateUserRequest.title: CreateUserRequest

Easing.description: Fitted timing function. ``keyword`` is set only when the fit *is* a CSS keyword curve.

rmse.description: Progress RMSE of the fit (0..1 progress units).
rmse.title: Rmse

Easing.title: Easing

ErrorCode.description: Closed set of error codes shared with the frontend (``web/lib/types.ts``).
ErrorCode.title: ErrorCode

Health.description:
``GET /api/health``. Never calls ``claude`` or the LLM gateway.

``interpreter`` and ``limits`` are null for anonymous callers and for sessions with a
pending forced password change (PLAN-auth A12); ``status``/``version``/``ffmpeg`` are public.
Health.title: Health

available.description: claude_cli: shutil.which(MIMIC_CLAUDE_BIN) is not None. openai_compat: MIMIC_LLM_BASE_URL + MIMIC_LLM_API_KEY + MIMIC_LLM_MODEL are configured (no network call). none: false.
available.title: Available

HealthLimits.description: Upload limits the server enforces (from settings), so the client can pre-check them.

duration_tolerance_s.description: Extra seconds tolerated over the maximum.
duration_tolerance_s.title: Duration Tolerance S

HealthLimits.title: HealthLimits

InterpretRequest.description:
``POST /api/jobs/{id}/interpret`` body. ``use_interpreter`` is required (no default): the
request itself is the user's explicit choice to send keyframes to the AI interpreter
(``true``) or to go back to heuristic labels (``false``).
InterpretRequest.title: InterpretRequest

Interpretation.description: Which Layer B provider produced labels/roles/structure and how it went.
Interpretation.title: Interpretation

InterpreterCheck.description:
``POST /api/interpreter/check``: actively test the configured interpreter.

``ok: false`` is a normal 200 answer (with ``error``). Probe fields are null when that probe
did not run (e.g. ``supports_images`` for ``claude_cli`` without a deep check).

model_listed.description: openai_compat: the model id appears in GET /models.
model_listed.title: Model Listed

InterpreterCheck.title: InterpreterCheck

JobList.description:
``GET /api/jobs``: newest first (``created_at`` desc, ``id`` desc), keyset-paginated.

Pass ``next_cursor`` back as ``cursor`` for the next page; null on the last page.
JobList.title: JobList

JobOptions.description: Upload form options echoed back. ``use_interpreter`` is opt-in (default off, PLAN P9).
JobOptions.title: JobOptions

JobOwner.description: The account that uploaded a job.
JobOwner.title: JobOwner

JobSource.description: Probe summary; null until probing finished.
JobSource.title: JobSource

JobState.description: Top-level job status: ``queued -> processing -> succeeded | failed``.
JobState.title: JobState

JobStatus.description:
``GET /api/jobs/{id}``. Poll until ``status`` is terminal.

``error`` is normally null unless ``status`` is ``failed``. Exception: a ``succeeded`` job
whose interpretation re-run failed keeps its previous result and reports that failure here.
``owner`` is null only for legacy jobs uploaded before accounts existed (admin-only).
JobStatus.title: JobStatus

KeyframeArtifact.description: One PNG. ``t_ms`` is null for composite images (element crops).
KeyframeArtifact.title: KeyframeArtifact

LoginRequest.description: ``POST /api/auth/login`` body. The username is stripped + lowercased server-side.
LoginRequest.title: LoginRequest

MeasuredNumber.description: A static (non-animated) measurement with its own confidence.
MeasuredNumber.title: MeasuredNumber

MeasuredShadow.description: Static shadow estimate. ``value: null`` = none or very subtle.
MeasuredShadow.title: MeasuredShadow

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp set by the pipeline.
generated_at.title: Generated At

disclaimer.default: Values are visual estimates from a screen recording, not source CSS.
disclaimer.title: Disclaimer

MotionElement.description: A changed UI element. Children's transforms are relative to ``parent_id``.

bbox_active.description: Box in state B (active / open / pressed).

MotionElement.title: MotionElement

MotionSpec.description: Root of the IR. Cross-references (element/segment/transition ids) are validated.

initial_state.description: Element -> property -> value before the forward motion.
initial_state.title: Initial State

active_state.description: Element -> property -> value after the forward motion.
active_state.title: Active State

MotionSpec.title: MotionSpec

Outputs.description: The four text tabs. Serialized keys: ``technical``, ``llm_prompt``, ``css``, ``json``.

json.description: Pretty IR export without transition samples.
json.title: Json

Outputs.title: Outputs

PxValue.description: Length in CSS px (translate, height, border-radius).
PxValue.title: PxValue

Relationship.description:
Timing relation between transitions of one segment (PLAN §6.9).

``transition_ids[0]`` is the reference (primary) transition. ``offset_ms`` is the start
offset of the others relative to it; ``interval_ms`` is the stagger step.
Relationship.title: Relationship

Segment.description:
An analysed motion window. ``fwd``/``rt_in`` are forward, ``rev``/``rt_out`` reverse.

``start_ms``/``end_ms`` = detected active run; ``onset_ms``/``settle_ms`` = earliest fitted
start / latest fitted end of its transitions; ``trigger_event_ms`` = cursor enter/click time.
Segment.title: Segment

ShadowValue.description: Box shadow. ``shadow: null`` means ``none`` / not detectable.
ShadowValue.title: ShadowValue

Source.description: Input video facts. ``width``/``height`` are source pixels after rotation (not CSS px).

container.description: e.g. mp4, mov, webm (from ffprobe format).
container.title: Container

Source.title: Source

Stage.description:
Pipeline stage. ``done`` is set together with ``succeeded``.

On failure the stage stays at the stage that failed, so the UI can say where.
Stage.title: Stage

TemporaryPassword.description:
``POST /api/admin/users`` (201) and ``.../reset-password`` (200).

``temporary_password`` is shown once; the account must change it at next sign-in.
TemporaryPassword.title: TemporaryPassword

TextValue.description: Opaque content description (``content`` property; not measured geometrically).
TextValue.title: TextValue

TotalDuration.description: ``settle - onset`` per direction; ``reverse`` is null when no reverse was recorded.
TotalDuration.title: TotalDuration

Transition.description: One property animating on one element in one segment.

delta.description: to - from for px/ratio values; null for color/shadow/text.
delta.title: Delta

start_ms.description: Absolute video time of the fitted start (t0).
start_ms.title: Start Ms

samples.description: [t_ms, progress] pairs for timeline/debug. Excluded from the JSON export.
samples.title: Samples

Transition.title: Transition

UpdateUserRequest.description: ``PATCH /api/admin/users/{id}`` body. At least one field must be set (non-null).
UpdateUserRequest.title: UpdateUserRequest
